description: This file defines constants for standard PDF filters and provides a static factory class 'Filtering' for retrieving and using these filters. It handles the mapping of filter names to filter objects, and offers encoding/decoding functionalities for PDF stream data using these filters.

classes.name: PdfFilterNames
classes.description: Contains constants representing the names (and abbreviations) of standard PDF filter algorithms.

classes.name: Filtering
classes.description: Provides static methods to retrieve filter objects by name and to perform encoding/decoding operations on data streams, supporting various PDF filters.

methods.name: GetFilter
methods.description: Returns the filter object corresponding to a given filter name or abbreviation.

methods.name: Encode
methods.description: Encodes data using the specified filter.

methods.name: Decode
methods.description: Decodes data using the specified filter, considering decoding parameters.

methods.name: DecodeToString
methods.description: Decodes binary data to a string using a specified filter and decoding parameters.
